text:
### Collection Process  
**Option 1: In-Person (Branch)**
- Customer brings document to branch
- Staff member verifies original (check for tampering)
- Photocopy document
- File copy with address change request
- Confirm document details in system  
**Option 2: Online Upload**
- Customer logs into online banking
- Uploads image/PDF of document
- System prompts for document type and date
- Compliance verifies upload legibility
- File stored securely  
**Option 3: Email**
- Customer emails photo/scan to: kyc@firstuk.bank
- Subject: "Address Change - [Account Number]"
- Compliance verifies and files
- Confirm receipt to customer  
**Option 4: Post**
- Customer mails original or certified copy
- FirstUK receives and verifies
- Document filed
- Original returned if requested
- Slower method (5–7 days)

raw_entities.name: Address Change Collection Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for customers to submit proof of address documentation to support an address change request. The process offers four collection channels: in-person branch verification, online upload via banking portal, email submission, or postal delivery. Each channel includes document verification, filing, and customer confirmation steps.
context: Customer mails original or certified copy

raw_entities.name: In-Person Document Verification
raw_entities.description: Staff member at branch location verifies the original proof of address document for signs of tampering or fraud, then creates a photocopy for filing with the address change request.
context: Staff member verifies original (check for tampering)
File copy with address change request

raw_entities.name: System Recording of Document Details
raw_entities.description: Staff member confirms and records the document details in the banking system to complete the in-person collection workflow.

raw_entities.name: Online Document Upload
raw_entities.description: Customer uploads an image or PDF of proof of address through the online banking portal, with the system prompting for document type and date information.
context: System prompts for document type and date

raw_entities.name: Compliance Legibility Verification
raw_entities.description: Compliance team verifies that uploaded documents are legible and of sufficient quality for processing, then stores the file securely in the system.

raw_entities.name: Email Document Submission
raw_entities.description: Customer emails a photo or scan of proof of address to the designated compliance mailbox with the account number in the subject line.

raw_entities.name: Email Document Verification and Filing
raw_entities.description: Compliance team verifies the emailed document and files it in the system, then sends receipt confirmation to the customer.

raw_entities.name: Postal Document Submission
raw_entities.description: Customer mails an original or certified copy of proof of address to FirstUK, which receives, verifies, and files the document. Original may be returned upon request.
context: Customer mails original or certified copy

raw_entities.name: Branch Staff
raw_entities.description: Bank staff member at a branch location responsible for verifying original proof of address documents, checking for tampering, creating photocopies, and recording document details in the system during in-person address change submissions.
context: Staff member verifies original (check for tampering)

raw_entities.name: Compliance Team
raw_entities.description: Compliance department responsible for verifying legibility of uploaded documents, reviewing emailed submissions, filing documents securely, and confirming receipt to customers across online, email, and postal collection channels.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Individual customer initiating an address change by submitting proof of address documentation through one of four available collection channels: in-person at branch, online portal, email, or postal mail.
context: Customer mails original or certified copy

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address
raw_entities.description: Official documentation submitted by customer to verify their current residential address as part of an address change request. Accepted in multiple formats: original document, certified copy, photocopy, or digital image/PDF.
context: Customer mails original or certified copy

raw_entities.name: Address Change Request
raw_entities.description: Formal request submitted by customer to update their registered address on file, supported by proof of address documentation collected through one of four available channels.
context: File copy with address change request

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address Document
raw_entities.description: Official identification or utility document accepted to verify a customer's current residential address. The document may be submitted as an original, certified copy, photocopy, or digital image/PDF depending on the collection channel selected.
context: Customer mails original or certified copy
System prompts for document type and date
